title: When is the lowest common multiple one of the two numbers?
description: The lowest common multiple of three and twenty four is twenty four, one of the two numbers. More pairs like this are found, the pattern is described in words, and then written with letters as n and k times n. The pattern is checked on the pair from the book.
teaching_notes: One idea: the lowest common multiple is one of the two numbers exactly when one number is a factor of the other, and then it is the bigger number. Ask the class for their own pairs before the working is shown. Watch for students who multiply the two numbers and call the product the lowest common multiple.

video_script.why: The child saw when the highest common factor is one of the two numbers and now asks the same question for the lowest common multiple.
video_script.substitution: If the smaller number goes into the bigger one, the bigger number is already a multiple of both, so it is the lowest common multiple.
video_script.anchor: The pair 3 and 24 written side by side with the words LCM 24 below it, and three empty pair boxes beside it.
video_script.payoff_line: The pair n and k times n has the lowest common multiple k times n

final_answer.value: (a) for example 5, 20 and 4, 12 (b) one number is a factor of the other; the pair n, kn has LCM kn
final_answer.spoken: one number is a factor of the other

never_show: a product of the two numbers as the LCM, marked right
maths_rules: 3 and 24: 24 = 3 × 8, the LCM is 24, which is one of the two numbers
if one number is a factor of the other, the bigger number is a multiple of both and no common multiple can be smaller than the bigger number, so the LCM is the bigger number
algebra: the pair n and kn, where k is a positive whole number; kn is a multiple of n and of itself, so the LCM is kn
check: n = 3 and k = 8 give 3 and 24, with LCM 24

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>This is a question from your book.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The lowest common multiple of three and twenty four is twenty four, one of the two numbers.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The lowest number that both numbers divide is called their lowest common multiple.
<bookmark mark='m4'/>We must find more pairs like this, and say what they have in common.
<bookmark mark='m5'/>Then we describe such pairs using algebra.
